item.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with drones and missiles, killing 3 in Kyiv
item.description: Kyiv: Russia attacked Ukraine with drones and missiles, killing three and injuring at least 16 in the capital overnight into Friday, Ukrainian authorities said. item.title: Two Indians living illegally in US arrested for smuggling over 300 pounds of cocaine
item.description: New York: Two Indians, living illegally in the US, have been arrested by federal authorities for smuggling more than 300 pounds of cocaine inside a semi-truck.
